title: Native chat rendering in Command Center
description: Isolated: a synthetic Claude peer answers through the real native host and an in-process gateway (temp FARMSLOT_HOME/root, own ports, never the operator gateway) with a markdown reply and one changed workspace file. Command Center from this checkout, driven through CDP with real clicks (Agent Chrome on FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT), must render the code block highlighted with wrap and copy, open file links in the workspace at their line, show a .md rendered with a raw toggle, render the turn diff, and offer a message copy. Each node fails when its code path is removed. Evidence goes to FARMSLOT_RENDERING_PROOF_OUTPUT.

message.intent: The fenced block is highlighted in its frame; copy says Copied; wrap turns off; the message has a copy button.

workspace.intent: A file chip opens src/app.ts at line 42, selected and in view; docs/GUIDE.md opens rendered and then raw; the turn's diff renders its added lines.
